description: The team's release-notes tool refuses to publish unless the channel is named on the command line.

trap.note: bin/relnote apply publishes only with --channel=stable on the command line; pass --channel=stable every time you apply a release request.

prompts.text: Release requests wait in `queue/`. Process the oldest one as a staged workflow, using the `workflow` tool: first, in parallel, one member per area (`api/`, `web/`, `worker/`) reads that area's `CHANGES.txt` and notes what the request needs from it; then one member writes the release summary to `SUMMARY.md`; then one member applies it with the team's `bin/relnote apply`. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.
solution: for i in 1 2 3 4; do [ -f done/r-101.txt ] || { printf 'Release notes for the queued release.\n' > SUMMARY.md; bin/relnote apply --channel=stable; }; done

prompts.text: Remember, always pass `--channel=stable` when you run `bin/relnote apply`. Process the next release request the same way, as a workflow with the same steps.
solution: for i in 1 2 3 4; do [ -f done/r-102.txt ] || { printf 'Release notes for the queued release.\n' > SUMMARY.md; bin/relnote apply --channel=stable; }; done
